name: adlc-marketplace
description: Marketplace for the ADLC (Agentic Delivery Lifecycle) plugin: repo intake, containerisation, Terraform, CI/CD, deployment verification and work tracking driven from Claude Code.

plugins.name: adlc
plugins.description: Agentic Delivery Lifecycle: interview-driven intake of a repo, app classification, hardened multi-stage Dockerfiles, Terraform (Azure), GitHub Actions CI/CD with immutable tags, deployment verification and Jira tracking. Option-based: cloud, compute, registry, runner, versioning, branching, tracker and secret store are chosen per repo.
